description: Authored diagnostic fixture. Labels were fixed before inference; this is not a held-out research benchmark.

examples.evidence: The trial enrolled 120 adults.
examples.claim: There were 120 adult participants in the trial.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: The intervention lasted six weeks.
examples.claim: Participants received the intervention for six weeks.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: The control group improved its attention score by 2 points.
examples.claim: The control group had a 2-point improvement in attention score.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: The study was observational and cannot establish causation.
examples.claim: The study cannot establish a causal relationship.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: No children were recruited for the trial.
examples.claim: Children were excluded from the trial.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: The trial took place at a single university.
examples.claim: The research was conducted at one university.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: The treatment did not improve attention compared with the control group.
examples.claim: There was no improvement in attention relative to the control group.
examples.label: supported

examples.evidence: Average nightly sleep increased from 6.2 hours to 7.5 hours.
examples.claim: After the intervention, average nightly sleep was 7.5 hours.
examples.label: supported
